text: Release configuration uses different keyed dimensions for different decisions. Flatpak branch and application identity are keyed by project; version bump file selection is keyed by release type. Current stable Flatpak routing covers comm-release and comm-esr.*, while ESR has a separate application ID and name. Reuse the existing beta-versus-release/ESR bump-file lesson. For changes in these mappings, choose the dimension that the consumer actually resolves rather than substituting a similarly named project. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or accessibility session was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Keep project routing separate from release-type decisions
